summary: iter113 — Bluetooth Beacon + WLAN-SSID Multi-Signal Boost VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed for PATCH geofence (wifi_ssid + bluetooth_beacon_id), and check-presence under 5 GPS/WiFi/BT scenarios (wifi_match far-GPS → match_source='wifi'; bluetooth far-GPS → match_source='bluetooth'; near-GPS+wifi → match_source='combined'; far-GPS+bad-ssid → match_source=null; near-GPS+bad-ssid → match_source='gps'). Frontend (staff_session cookie ee9686ea-...): /staff/portal loads, staff-nearby-card visible and tappable; clicking opens smart-setup-sheet with capabilities banner ('Browser-Modus'/'Native App erkannt'); smart-setup-ssid-input + smart-setup-ssid-save fill+save 'Termokos-Office' → toast 'WLAN-Name gespeichert' visible AND localStorage['staff_wifi_ssid_override']='Termokos-Office' persisted; smart-setup-close dismisses sheet. useGeofenceWatch verified to send wifi_ssid in body via Playwright network capture: backend responses returned wifi_match=4f75e706-... after override set, and after reload with GPS near Termokos (42.66/21.16) match_source flipped GPS→'combined' on the live preview URL (proves end-to-end multi-signal integration). Regression: staff-chat-btn present, Wetter card text/°C visible, Arbeitszeit live-timer ticking (02:08→02:09). Bluetooth Web API is disabled in Playwright (capabilities.webBluetooth=false) and the 'Beacon scannen' button is correctly disabled — expected per problem statement.

issues: When GPS is far away from any fence (no nearest), the card branches to the 'Smart-Setup' CTA layout and the nearby-wifi-badge/nearby-bt-badge are NOT rendered even if smartPresence.wifi_match/bluetooth_match is set via the multi-signal boost. Badges currently only show when nearest?.geofence is truthy (line 614). Consider also rendering the wifi/bt badge in the fallback (Smart-Setup) branch so the user gets a 'Du bist via WLAN erkannt' hint when GPS is unreliable. Pure-frontend rendering note; backend boost itself works.

action_items: (Optional UX polish) Surface nearby-wifi-badge / nearby-bt-badge in the 'Smart-Setup' fallback branch of NearbyCard when smartPresence.wifi_match or bluetooth_match is set but no GPS-nearest fence exists, so the user can visually confirm Multi-Signal Boost worked even far from GPS-radius.

Note for next iteration: teleportation-spoof guard correctly fires when GPS jumps >200km/h between events (verified: after Termokos events stored, a hop to lat 52/13 within seconds is rejected). This is expected behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: staff_geofence.py check_presence multi-signal boost (lines 326-340) is clean and correct: GPS-inside takes priority for match_source='gps', WiFi/BT-only boosts to inside_fence with match_source='wifi'|'bluetooth', combined case correctly upgrades to 'combined'. Spoof-guard short-circuits boost which is the right behaviour.

useSmartSignals.js: localStorage override pattern (SSID_OVERRIDE_KEY) is robust, capabilities detection runs once via useEffect (line 43), polling refreshWifi every 60s. setWifiOverride correctly persists+updates state in one call. Web Bluetooth + Capacitor branches both wired.
StaffPortalPage NearbyCard: minor — wifi/bt badges only render inside the `fence ? (...)` branch (line 614). Could be lifted up so multi-signal-without-nearest case still shows badge.
Backend response field naming is consistent (match_source / wifi_match / bluetooth_match) — frontend usage in StaffPortalPage matches.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sheet opens/closes, ssid persists in localStorage, toast shows, capabilities banner shows, check-presence fires with wifi_ssid evidenced by wifi_match in response, combined match_source observed live, chat+weather+timer regression OK)
